status: DRAFT: art NOT signed off by Gary. Not wired in.
palette: art/world/overworld/palette.hex (every src and dst colour is from it)
how_to_apply: For a Cosmic creature, recolour every sprite (battle front/back + idle frames, overworld frames, party icon) with swaps[creature]: exact #rrggbb match, alpha unchanged, ONLY on pixels outside the crystal mask (Warmth masks: art/characters/pixel/warmth/masks/<creature>/...). Colours not listed are left alone. Crystal pixels are never touched by this swap, so they stay violet and Crystal Warmth still applies. Order: 1) cosmic swap, 2) Crystal Warmth swap (inside mask), 3) time-of-day sprite grade. All swaps are single-pass lookups on the ORIGINAL colour (do not chain: a dst that is also a src must not be swapped again).
vfx: Starfield shimmer on encounter, the 3-note chime and the 4 s icon twinkle are NOT here. Those are for the Animator/Coder.
